'''Markus Wuest Crazy U-turn''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Markus Wuest]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/decks99l.htm Crazy U-turn], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228072145/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/decks99l.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Markus Wuest]]
